howtos.title: Ask for the spread, not the likeliest answer
howtos.what: Ruben Hassid's prompt pushes Claude past generic ideas by asking for 20 options ranked by how unlikely they are.
copy: Give me 20 very different options. For each one, tell me how likely another AI would give it to me. The last two must be under 10%.
howtos.whenToUse: When brainstorming and the model keeps giving the same safe, generic ideas.

howtos.title: Give Claude a finish line
howtos.what: State what done means so Claude stops at the result you need, per Ruben Hassid.
copy: Done means: a one-page doc my boss can forward without editing.
howtos.whenToUse: When Claude stops too early or delivers something you still have to rework.

howtos.title: Build a shared domain language with your coding agent
howtos.what: Matt Pocock's domain-driven design loop: name the domain, use those words with the agent, refactor to match.
copy: Build a ubiquitous language for your domain.
Use that language with the agent.
Refactor the code to use it.
howtos.whenToUse: When agent output drifts because code and conversations use different names for the same business ideas.
